spots.name: Black Mountain Lookout
spots.tip: A lookout tower or fire lookout: a full-circle view, so it works at sunrise and sunset. Many are staffed in summer and some can be rented.

spots.name: Senator Clinton P. Anderson Wilderness Overlook
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint. Check which way it faces: east for sunrise, west for sunset. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.

spots.name: Austin Roberts Vista

spots.name: Jordan Hot Springs
spots.tip: Steam reads best in cold air at first light. Check access rules; many springs are on private or tribal land.

spots.name: Gila / Lightfeather Hot Springs
spots.tip: Steam reads best in cold air at first light. Check access rules; many springs are on private or tribal land.

spots.name: Turkeyfeather Pass
spots.tip: A mountain pass: easy high ground by car. Fog often fills the valleys on either side at sunrise; check winter road conditions.

spots.name: Ridge Tank
spots.tip: A lake: calm air at dawn gives mirror reflections, and mist often sits on the water on cold mornings. The pin marks the middle of the lake: pick a shore spot facing the light.
